subtitles.text: Nine o'clock at night, southern Taiwan:
air conditioners running across the island.
Nobody at the substations touched them.
By the end of the hour
the chip factories that make most
of the world's most advanced processors
And the question is no longer

shots.caption: Thirty seconds earlier, every light on the island was on.

labels.text: Not: will the lights come back
